articles.title: GST collections rise 22.9% to Rs 2.31 lakh crore in October
articles.summary: October witnessed a remarkable surge in India's Goods and Services Tax revenues, hitting Rs 2.31 lakh crore, reflecting a commendable 22.9% growth from last year. This rise was primarily fueled by a staggering 42.2% increase in imports and consistent domestic transactions.

articles.title: India's record oil imports hit 5.6 million bpd as Middle East, Russia supplies rise: Report

articles.title: GST collections hit ₹2.31 lakh crore in Oct, up 22.9% YoY on robust domestic growth
articles.summary: The cumulative gross GST collection for the first seven months of the current fiscal year (April-October 2026) stood at Rs 14,77,569 crore, registering a steady 13.2% growth over the Rs 13,05,213 crore recorded during the same period in the previous financial year.

articles.title: Commercial LPG price hiked by Rs 10; ATF rates up for fourth straight month

articles.title: 93% drop in Q2 profit despite record sales: Why rising input cost is squeezing IGL
